LESSON: MATCHING

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: CLASSIFICATION
Topic 1.2: Matching

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Matching. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify similarities among 8 lessons
2. identify differences among objects in the environment 48
3. match objects according to likeness or sameness in the environment
4. pair objects related to each other according to sameness, likeness, use, type relationship, part and whole e) use appropriate vocabulary related to matching and pairing objects for effective communication f) appreciate the use of different objects in the environment from the environment. objects according to more than one attribute using ICT devices.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Matching. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Matching important to you?
